ResearchProjectDef.label: Active Matter Refining
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stabilization, handling, and refining methods for active matter allow the Rukaya's more advanced industry to function again.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Is It Over?
ResearchProjectDef.description: The Rukaya have restored the foundations of their industry, equipment, and mechanoid production, completing the first phase of reconstruction.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic Rukaya Apparel
ResearchProjectDef.description: Basic tailoring patterns adapted for Rukaya anatomy make it possible to reproduce simple, dependable clothing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Rukaya Apparel
ResearchProjectDef.description: Improved construction techniques and finer finishing methods support more sophisticated Rukaya garments.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Rukaya Combat Apparel
ResearchProjectDef.description: Dedicated battlefield tailoring, reinforcement patterns, and modular fittings make it possible to produce Rukaya combat garments suited for sustained deployment.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic Rukaya Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Recovered weapon principles and simplified fabrication steps allow the production of basic Rukaya arms.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Standardized Rukaya Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: With active matter processing understood, standardized Rukaya weapon designs can be manufactured to a proper military pattern.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Rukaya Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refined fabrication standards and deeper restoration of military schematics unlock more advanced Rukaya weapons for frontline use.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Large-Scale Active Matter Refining
ResearchProjectDef.description: Scaling active matter processing beyond laboratory and workshop methods supports bulk refinement without making it a required pillar of reconstruction.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Rukaya Mechanized Units
ResearchProjectDef.description: Recovered doctrines for autonomous chassis, weapon integration and control routines provide the basis for rebuilding practical Rukaya mechanized units.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Air-defense missiles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Active-matter interceptors and coordinated fire-control systems enable fixed surface-to-air missile launchers and missile-armed Rukaya mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Equipment Template Scanning
ResearchProjectDef.description: Triplex-ray analysis can recover reproducible active-matter templates from existing weapons and apparel, even when their original research path has been lost.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Active Matter Equipment Printing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stabilized template reconstruction allows autonomous terminals to print selected weapon and apparel patterns at controlled materials and quality levels.
